A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], by which time he had also begun working with a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-pilot. In 3 BBY he played [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] with the [[Riileb (species)|Riileb]] [[Tere Metallo]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
